text:
Maya P: Quick sync — vendor timelines have drifted a bit. We need a short alignment on testing windows, SI integration handoffs, and joint customer comms for H100/H200, MI300, and Gaudi. Who can join a 20m checkpoint tomorrow? :calendar:

Liam K: I can do tomorrow 10:30 PT. Main risk is firmware tag for H200 that blocks our perf kernels. :eyes:

Sanjay R: +1 for 10:30. Also need to confirm MI300 driver ABI freeze date from AMD partner team — currently targeting 5/20. If that slips we lose one week of validation.

Tess L: Adding packaging/marketplace ask — marketplace image needs final kernel bits 48h before public announce. If SI needs extra time we should bake that into the timeline.

Maya P: Good call. Proposed short plan: 1) lock kernel/firmware freeze dates from vendors, 2) commit internal test windows, 3) decide canary day and comms embargo. Quick straw timeline in case vendors hold current targets:

```
HW | vendor freeze | our test window | canary announce
H100/H200 | 2026-05-12 | 2026-05-13 -> 2026-05-18 | 2026-05-20
MI300 | 2026-05-20 | 2026-05-21 -> 2026-05-27 | 2026-05-29
Gaudi | 2026-05-28 | 2026-05-29 -> 2026-06-04 | 2026-06-07
```

Liam K: That looks reasonable. For H100/H200 infra team needs to reserve lab capacity (x8 runs) on 5/13-5/16. I'll file a booking request after meeting.

Sanjay R: I'll ping AMD and request formal confirmation of ABI freeze and whether they expect a backfill patch. If they say backfill allowed we need to include regression test in our window.

Tess L: For marketplace/partner packaging I'll plan for a final image cut 48h before canary and a docs draft 72h before canary. If SI integrations require additional certs we should surface that.

Infra CI Bot: nightly-build: gpu-kernels/main @ 3665000010 - 4 tests failed (kv-cache, fused-mha). See logs: https://ci.redwood.example/runs/4821 (reaction :warning:)

Liam K: Noted — those fused-mha failures could be due to an API drift in the new H200 firmware. I'll triage first thing in the morning.

Maya P: OK next steps: 1) join 10:30 PT checkpoint (tomorrow) — I'll send calendar, 2) @Sanjay R to confirm vendor freeze ASAP, 3) @Liam K to reserve lab slots and triage CI failures, 4) @Tess L to draft marketplace image cut plan. We'll use this thread for short async updates. :thumbsup:

Sanjay R: Pinged AMD + vendor contacts, asked for written freeze confirmation and estimated slip window. Will post reply here when they confirm.

Liam K: Lab booking submitted (req #LB-3982) for 5/13-5/16 x8. CI triage started, short-term workaround branch created: `hotfix/fused-mha-compat`.

Tess L: Drafted marketplace checklist and uploaded to drive: https://drive.redwood/example/marketplace-cut-3665 — will iterate after canary date is locked.

Maya P: Great, thanks team. If vendors confirm no slip we keep the straw timeline. If any vendor pushes more than 3 days we reconvene and push canary by a week. See you at 10:30.
